description: This file is a shell script intended to manage the setup, building, patching, and testing of a complex software project involving multiple repositories like Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, and GoogleTest. It automates cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring and building components with CMake, copying plugins, running tests, and generating coverage reports. The script also handles environment preparation, package installation, and coverage data filtering.
